==============================================================================
  APEX RADIANCE {VERSION}  -  INSTALL BY HAND
==============================================================================

  Easier way: Apex Radiance Setup (ApexRadianceSetup.exe) does all of
  this for you. It is one folder up in the Nexus download, and a file of
  its own on the GitHub release page.

  Where files go: the game's Bin folder, called "Game\Bin" below.

    Steam ..... Steam\steamapps\common\The Sims 3\Game\Bin
    EA app .... EA Games\The Sims 3\Game\Bin
    (your folder may differ: find "Game\Bin" inside your The Sims 3 folder)


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  STEP 1  -  CLOSE THE GAME
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Close The Sims 3 and its launcher.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  STEP 2  -  AN ASI LOADER  (skip if you already have one)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Apex Radiance is an .asi mod: the game needs an ASI loader to load it.
    If you already use another .asi mod (for example Sims3SettingsSetter),
    you have one. If not, get Ultimate ASI Loader (32-bit) and put it in
    Game\Bin:
      https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  STEP 3  -  APEX RADIANCE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Copy ApexRadiance.asi (from this folder) into Game\Bin.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  STEP 4  -  RENDERER  (optional, pick one)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    A.  DXVK  -  fewer stutters; Apex Radiance is made and tested with it
          Put DXVK's 32-bit d3d9.dll in Game\Bin.

    B.  RTX Remix bridge (experimental)  -  about 600 MB more free memory
          for big worlds (needs a Vulkan graphics card)
          1. Download the RTX Remix bridge: the "RTX Remix bridge" file on
             Nexus, or Apex-Radiance-RTX-Remix-bridge.zip on GitHub.
          2. Move any d3d9.dll already in Game\Bin to a backup folder.
          3. Unzip the bridge into Game\Bin, keeping its .trex folder.
          4. EA app only: in both bridge.conf files (Game\Bin and
             Game\Bin\.trex), change
               client.targetProcess = TS3W.exe
             to
               client.targetProcess = TS3.exe


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  STEP 5  -  RESTART HOST  (optional, experimental)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    After a save that leaves the game little free memory, quitting the
    game asks whether to start it again straight into that save.

    1.  Copy ts3wrap.exe (from this folder) into Game\Bin, next to
        ApexRadiance.asi.
    2.  Start the game once and close it, so the settings file exists.
    3.  Open Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3\Apex Radiance\
        ApexRadiance.toml in Notepad, find the line  [ui]  and add
        right under it:
          restart_host = true

    Skip this step if you do not want it: without the line, ts3wrap.exe
    does nothing.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  STEP 6  -  PLAY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Start the game, load a world and press  Ctrl + Shift + F11  to open
    the Apex Radiance menu.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UPDATING
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Close the game and replace ApexRadiance.asi (and ts3wrap.exe and the
    bridge files, if you use them) with the new ones. Your settings stay
    in:
      Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3\Apex Radiance
